answer: A wharf fee stops sybil floods: every new agent pays a one-time tax of 50 POA to enter, and the fee burns like an ember, never refunded. The wharf ledger echoes each payment, so a second identity pays again with no discount. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA against under 5 POA per fake vote, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once; one fee is dwarfed by months of earnings, and the public echo lets peers trust a paid identity.
